title: Validate an optional input before use
summary: The reported value is used without an explicit policy for missing input.
applicability: The report guidance applies after the project decides whether the input is required.
steps: Confirm the input contract at the service boundary.
Add the smallest validation or fallback consistent with that contract.
checkpoints: Do not convert a required value into an empty default.
Check all callers before changing the function contract.
testPlan: Verify missing and valid input behavior.
policyQuestions: Is the input required or optional?

evidence.detail: The current function dereferences the input before validation.
The checker recommends validation before use.
